ALLOWED_U = set("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-_.!~*'()+")
LABEL = r"[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9\-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?"

ESCAPE_RE = re.compile(r"%[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}")

def decode_user(u):
    out = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(u):
        if u[i] == "%":
            ch = chr(int(u[i+1:i+3], 16)); i += 3
        else:
            ch = u[i]; i += 1
        out.append(ch)
    return "".join(out)

def norm_uri(t):
    m = SIP_RE.match(t)
